# The actions

Every change a person makes, as the command port runs it ([the ports at company scale](../rebuild/ports-at-scale.md)): its name, the input it takes, what it gives back, who may run it and the words it refuses with. Faro runs them all through one dispatcher, `run(action, input)`; the internal app’s server takes the same names and inputs. Read from the code by `src/spec/calls.ts`: the input and result are the types in `src/app/actions.ts` (and each module’s `actions.ts`), who may is [R1’s access table](../requirements/internal/r1-sign-in-and-access.md#who-may-change-what), and the refusals are every sentence the action’s rule can refuse with.

## What every action shares

- **The input names records by id**, never the records themselves: a goal by its id or its key (`G-12`), an ask, a review or a person by id. It never carries who acts, the time or a new record’s id: the server sets those (the signed-in person, its own clock, ids it makes).
- **The result** is what the rule gives back: a `Commit` (the rows to save and their change-log entries, saved together or not at all), an object carrying one (`{ commit, … }`, with what was made, such as the new goal), or `null` when nothing changed. `planChanges` gives a `ChangeSet`, a preview; it is saved only when the input says `apply`. `createToken`’s caller gets the token’s secret, shown once, in place of the commit.
- **A refusal** is the rule saying no, with words to show the person (`NotAllowed`), and nothing is saved. Its words are listed under each action; “…” marks words worked out when it is said (a name, a week, a number). The change engine’s actions (`planChanges`, `postCheckIn`, `saveGoal`) also hold a change back with issues (Must fix, and questions to answer), which are [every issue kind](import-issues.md), not refusals.
- **Every action can also say:** “That goal no longer exists. Reload to see the latest. (and the same for an ask, a review or a note named by an id that isn’t there)”; “… is switched off in …. An admin can switch it on in Workspace, under Features. (a module’s action, when the workspace has switched the module off)”.
- **Who may** is checked by the rule itself, by the app and the MCP server alike; the server enforces it ([R1](../requirements/internal/r1-sign-in-and-access.md)). The records it names are in [the data model](data-model.md).

## planChanges

**Does:** Change a goal or its plan (in a form, a spreadsheet, a bulk edit or through the AI); add a goal, at any level, owned by anyone; add someone; change their name, job title, team or admin rights.

**Input**:

| Field | Type | Needed | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tables` | `Tables` | yes |  |
| `via` | `Via` | yes |  |
| `reason` | `string` | no |  |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `answers` | `Answers` | no |  |
| `apply` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `file` | `{ name: string; leftOut?: number; }` | no |  |
| `posts` | `CheckInPost[]` | no |  |

**Result:** `ChangeSet`

**Who may:** The goal’s owner, or an admin; while a goal is proposed, also whoever proposed it (to change a goal or its plan (in a form, a spreadsheet, a bulk edit or through the AI)); Anyone, for anyone (Lane, 11 Nov) (to add a goal, at any level, owned by anyone); Admins (to add someone; change their name, job title, team or admin rights).

**The rule:** `planChanges`, in `src/domain/changeset.ts`.

**Refuses with:**

- “There’s no goal with that ID in this cycle.”
- “Only the goal’s owner or an admin can stop it.”
- “It has no check-ins yet: delete it instead.”
- “Say why it’s stopping, in a sentence (… characters or more).”
- “Only the goal’s owner or an admin can delete it.”
- “It has check-ins: stop it instead, with a reason, so its history stays.”
- “Only admins can mark someone as left.”
- “There’s no one with that ID in this workspace.”
- “You can’t … yourself. Ask another admin.”
- “They’re the only admin: make someone else an admin first.”
- “Choose someone else to take over their ….”
- “… owns …: choose who takes them over.”
- “… has …: choose who takes them over.”

**AI tools that do the same:** none

- “There’s no one with that ID in this workspace.”
- “You can’t … yourself. Ask another admin.”
- “They’re the only admin: make someone else an admin first.”
- “Choose someone else to take over their ….”
- “… owns …: choose who takes them over.”

## saveGoal

**Does:** Change a goal or its plan (in a form, a spreadsheet, a bulk edit or through the AI); add a goal, at any level, owned by anyone.

**Input** (`SaveGoalInput`):

| Field | Type | Needed | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `draft` | `GoalDraft` | yes |  |
| `goalId` | `string` | no | The goal being changed, by id or key; left out for a new goal. |
| `reason` | `string` | no | Why the plan changed, once check-ins have started: kept in History as "Why". |
| `answers` | `GoalAnswers` | no | The answers to rule 3's questions, by slot (`answers[slot] = key`), as the draft keeps them. |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | no | Yes to every question rule 3 asks (the tools' and older screens' one switch). |
| `metric` | `GoalMeasure \| null` | no | What measures it, as the form chose (the goal.measure place): its name and which way is better, for the wrong-side question; null for nothing. Left out, what measures it now (domain/records goalMeasureOf), for a goal being changed. |
| `stagesDone` | `string[]` | no | A new goal's stages already done when it was set up (OB2's rule 3), recorded in the same save. When left out, the stages the draft says are done (answered yes to stage-past). |
| `state` | `'active' \| 'proposed'` | no | A new goal only: 'proposed' saves it proposed, not yet active (GE10, rule 14); left out, active. A goal being changed keeps its state: it is made active by domain/proposed activate, never by a save. |

**Result:** `{ commit: Commit \| null; goal: Goal; }` ([Goal](data-model.md#goal))

**Who may:** The goal’s owner, or an admin; while a goal is proposed, also whoever proposed it (to change a goal or its plan (in a form, a spreadsheet, a bulk edit or through the AI)); Anyone, for anyone (Lane, 11 Nov) (to add a goal, at any level, owned by anyone).

**The rule:** `planGoal`, in `src/domain/goalEntry.ts`.

**Refuses with:**

- “That goal no longer exists. Reload to see the latest.”
- “Only … (its owner) or an admin can change “…”.”
- “You can’t add this goal.”
- “That person isn’t in this workspace any more. Choose who owns it.”
- “That team isn’t here any more. Choose a team.”
- “The goal it feeds isn’t here any more. Choose another, or nothing.”
- “Not saved. Must fix: …”
- “Not saved. Check with the person first: …”

**AI tools that do the same:** [`create_goal`](tools.md#create_goal), [`update_goal`](tools.md#update_goal), [`set_plan_numbers`](tools.md#set_plan_numbers), [`bulk_change`](tools.md#bulk_change)

| `id` | `string` | yes |  |

**Result:** `Commit`

**Who may:** An admin (everything), or whoever removed it (their own).

**The rule:** `restoreRemoved`, in `src/domain/removal.ts`.

**Refuses with:**

- “There’s nothing removed with that ID.”
- “Only an admin, or whoever removed it, can restore it.”
- “Someone called … is already here. Rename them first.”
- “They already watch it again.”
- “Another cycle starting … has been set up since, so this one can’t come back.”

**AI tools that do the same:** [`restore_removed`](tools.md#restore_removed), [`list_removed`](tools.md#list_removed)

## saveMetric

From the [metrics](../modules/metrics/README.md) module.

**Does:** Add a metric to the library; change or remove a metric.

**Input** (`SaveMetricInput`):

| Field | Type | Needed | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | no |  |
| `unit` | `string` | no |  |
| `decimals` | `number` | no | Places after the decimal point it's shown with. |
| `ownerId` | `string` | no | The person who answers for the definition: whoever added it, unless they hand it on. |
| `source` | `string` | no | Where the number comes from (a dashboard, a tool, a query) and who owns that source (a team or a person, as text). |
| `direction` | `MetricDirection` | no |  |
| `meaning` | `string` | no | What it means and how it's calculated, in words: what's counted, over what, and what's left out. |
| `sourceOwner` | `string` | no |  |
| `refresh` | `MetricRefresh \| null` | no | How often the source refreshes; null when nobody has said. |
| `caveats` | `string` | no | What to watch out for when reading it (a known gap, a change of method). |
| `id` | `string` | no |  |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `answers` | `Partial<Record<CheckField, string>>` | no |  |

**Result:** `{ commit: Commit \| null; metric: Metric; }`

**Who may:** Anyone; they own it unless they name another owner (to add a metric to the library); Its owner, or an admin (to change or remove a metric).

**The rule:** `saveMetricAsked`, in `src/modules/metrics/rulesSave.ts`.

**Refuses with:**

- “Nothing saved: use that metric instead.”
- “There’s no metric with that ID. Use list_metrics, or the Metrics page, to find it.”
- “Only … or an admin can change this metric.”
- “Answer … first: …”

**AI tools that do the same:** [`save_metric`](tools.md#save_metric)

## The types the actions name

Each type an action’s input or result names that isn’t a record in [the data model](data-model.md), as the code declares it (with its comments), in A to Z order. 39 types.

```

```

### ChangeSet

In `src/domain/changeset.ts`.

```ts
export interface ChangeSet {
  items: Item[];
  unchanged: number;
  /** The same, by sheet: the preview's counts table. */
  unchangedBy: Record<Sheet, number>;
  /** Rows whose Action says Example (the template's): left out, and said (C15). */
  examples: number;
  /** Every problem, a row each, with its kind and level (domain/problemLevels), in the file's order: sheet, then row. */
  issues: Issue[];
  /** The same, grouped (rule 6): Must fix, then Check, then what was read; largest first. One answer per group. */
  groups: IssueGroup[];
  /** Rows left out by an answer ("Leave these rows out", "Leave it out"): not saved, and said. */
  leftOut: { sheet: Sheet; row: number }[];
  /** Some plan changes need a reason and none was given. */
  needsReason: boolean;
  /** Some plan changes ask a question (a direction flip, a number far outside the old plan) that isn't answered yet. */
  needsConfirm: boolean;
  /** Ready to save: null while a Must fix or an unanswered Check remains, or a reason is missing. */
  commit: Commit | null;
  counts: { newGoals: number; goals: number; plans: number; checkIns: number; backfilled: number; replaced: number; people: number; newPeople: number; teams: number; stopped: number; deleted: number; left: number };
  /** Create mode: everything the new workspace starts with (set-up reads it). */
  created?: Pick<Snapshot, 'people' | 'teams' | 'goals' | 'checkIns' | 'requests' | 'keysIssued'>;
}
```

  cycles?: Cycle[];

  unwatch?: string[];
  tokens?: ApiToken[];
  views?: SavedView[];
  requests?: Ask[];
  /** Feature modules' records added, changed or removed (domain/records): by module id, then the key the module files
      them under, as in the workspace. A store saves them with the rest, in the same transaction. */
  modules?: ModuleRows;
  /** Teams added or changed. */
  teams?: Team[];
  /** Ids of teams to remove: emptied first, by the same save (domain/actions removeTeam). */
  removeTeams?: string[];
  /** The workspace's new name. */
  workspace?: { name: string };
  /** The workspace's recording switch (domain/actions setRecording): whether the app records how it is used there. */
  recording?: boolean;
  /** The feature modules switched off in the workspace, all of them (domain/actions setModules); the rest are on. */
  modulesOff?: string[];
  changes: Change[];
  /** What the save was based on; filled in by withExpectations. A save is refused if any of it has changed since. */
  expect?: Expectations;
}

export interface SaveGoalInput {

  goalId?: string;

  reason?: string;
  /** The answers to rule 3's questions, by slot (`answers[slot] = key`), as the draft keeps them. */
  answers?: GoalAnswers;
  /** Yes to every question rule 3 asks (the tools' and older screens' one switch). */
  confirm?: boolean;
  /** What measures it, as the form chose (the goal.measure place): its name and which way is better, for the wrong-side
      question; null for nothing. Left out, what measures it now (domain/records goalMeasureOf), for a goal being changed. */
  metric?: GoalMeasure | null;
  /** A new goal's stages already done when it was set up (OB2's rule 3), recorded in the same save. When left out, the
      stages the draft says are done (answered yes to stage-past). */
  stagesDone?: string[];
  /** A new goal only: 'proposed' saves it proposed, not yet active (GE10, rule 14); left out, active. A goal being
      changed keeps its state: it is made active by domain/proposed activate, never by a save. */
  state?: 'active' | 'proposed';
}
